meta_description: GDR Painting & Decorating in Liverpool. Expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07806 791152.
hero_subhead: From fresh interior paint to full exterior makeovers, we transform your home with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: We handle everything from intimate bedroom refreshes to large commercial redecorations, inside and out.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform rooms with quality paints and finishes. We prepare walls properly, apply multiple coats where needed, and leave your home spotless. Every project backed by our finish guarantee.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting that protects and beautifies. We use trade-grade products suited to Liverpool's climate and complete full surface preparation.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Pattern-matched wallpaper hung perfectly, or textured coverings for character. We strip, prepare, and hang with precision — no bubbles, no wrinkles.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, fascias, and brickwork painted to last. We sand, prime, and finish in your chosen colour with a durable, professional result.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial spaces painted to spec on schedule. We work flexibly around your business hours and leave sites clean and ready.

services.title: Consultation & Design Advice
services.desc: Unsure of your colour scheme or finish? We offer free in-home consultations to help you choose the perfect palette and products for your space.

about_pullquote: A well-decorated home deserves craftsmanship, not shortcuts.
about_para_1: GDR Painting & Decorating was founded on a simple idea: deliver professional, reliable decorating that homeowners can trust. Based in Prescot, we've been serving Liverpool and surrounding areas for 18 years, completing over 500 residential and commercial projects. We're fully insured, trained to current standards, and take pride in every finish we produce.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on attention to detail, honest pricing, and showing up when we say we will. We don't cut corners on preparation — poor preparation leads to poor results, and we won't hand over your keys until the job meets our standard. Families and businesses across Merseyside come back to us time and again because they know what they're getting: quality work at fair prices.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About GDR

reviews.text: Needed the lounge and hallway done after water damage. GDR came out within a week, matched the existing paint perfectly, and finished on time. No mess, no fuss. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had the exterior of our Victorian terraced house painted. Worried about the woodwork and stonework, but they knew exactly what they were doing. Three-year guarantee on the work, competitive price, and they were here early every day. Will use them again.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Lovely lads. Stripped old wallpaper, made good the walls, and hung new paper in the bedroom without a mark. Tidy workers too — dropped sheets down, cleaned up after themselves. Cost less than the other quotes I got. Very happy.
reviews.author: Claire H.
